harness.name: AI Experiments repository-level coding-agent harness
harness.provenance: The published revision contains the reviewed v1 harness, analysis, protocol, and evidence; treatment-defining source and image hashes are additionally frozen by the routing and model locks.

campaigns.purpose: Measure the frozen local policy on six repository-disjoint calibration tasks.
Measure the paired Sonnet 4.6 cloud reference on the same six tasks.
Evaluate the frozen clean-fallback local-first policy and its observable routing decisions.

limitations: The calibration contains six Go tasks and one trajectory per task-policy pair.
The release supports method, infrastructure, routing, and feasibility claims but not population non-inferiority claims.
Hosted cost excludes local hardware, electricity, and opportunity cost.
One locally accepted patch failed held-out evaluation.
The confirmatory gate for the tested policy and original design is no-go.
